'''Piesa''' is a horse owned by [[Leya]].

==Appearance==
Piesa is a shaggy brown and white mare.

==Activities==
Piesa carries Leya into the [[Mountains of Mist]] to meet with [[Moiraine Damodred]].{{ref/book|3|1}}[[Perrin Aybara]] takes Piesa to be fed while Leya talks with Moiraine.{{ref/book|3|2}}
